row.evidence: Hatz's SSO (SAML) + SCIM help article says "MSPs and End Customers on SMB, Professional, and Business packages can configure SSO" and "SSO configuration requires SMB tier or higher"; Intro and Starter are the lowest tiers.
row.notes: Unchanged status (gated). Hatz sells only through MSP partners and publishes no prices. Help-centre docs say SSO (SAML) and SCIM need the SMB, Professional or Business package; the Intro and Starter plans are the lowest tiers and do not include SAML. SCIM 2.0 at https://admin.hatz.ai/api/scim/v2 with a bearer token; documented for Okta (custom SAML app) and Microsoft Entra ID (custom enterprise app), with push users, profile updates and groups; users are deactivated on unassign. Only a single default tenant role can be set on provisioned users. An admin REST API (X-API-Key) can invite, update, delete users and manage roles; its plan gate is not documented.

auth.token_source: admin.hatz.ai > Settings > SAML > Manage tenant > Configure SCIM Provisioning > Copy your SCIM Credentials (Primary Admin)

attributes.notes: userName carries the user's email; name and email sync per the FAQ, but attribute names beyond userName are not listed.

roles.how: Only a single 'Default Tenant Role' is applied to all newly provisioned users; IdP groups do not map to Hatz permissions.

limitations.text: SAML SSO must be configured and pass postflight before SCIM.
Okta 'Import New Users and Profile Updates' and 'Import Groups' are not supported.
A user must not be assigned to more than one tenant via SCIM.
SSO covers one verified email domain per connection; enabling SAML disables email/password login tenant-wide.
Generating a new SCIM token revokes the previous one.

endpoints.purpose: List assignable roles for a tenant

limitations.text: API keys are tied to a user and inherit that user's permissions; generating one needs the Create API Token permission.
Deleting a user removes their chats, integrations and Workshop items; nothing is transferred.

okta.notes: No OIN listing found (okta.com/integrations/hatz-ai 404); Hatz's guide uses a custom SAML app integration with SCIM enabled.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found; Hatz's guide uses a custom (non-gallery) enterprise app.
